verdict.rationale: Proa documents its own build-time diagnostics. Its template macro validates at compile time, `--deny warnings` flags specific performance problems, WCAG/ARIA checks fail the cargo build on markup defects, and editor tooling flags missing fields in paired Markdown views. Nothing describes the content or clarity of those messages, or how the dev server reports failures, so the core story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: any documentation or examples of the error-message format and actionability, dev-server error reporting (e.g. overlays or terminal output on rebuild failure), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the errors are clear.
